widgets-desc.life.desc: Screen capture / voice recording on-off. Turning it off frees the Whisper model (~3.1GB) from RAM.
widgets-desc.usertool.desc: Tools people built and uploaded — they only run inside a sandbox
widgets-desc.flow.desc: Chain tools together into your own sequence and save it
widgets-desc.settings.desc: Theme · API keys · what is stored in this browser
widgets-desc.status.desc: Whether it is running well and what changed recently — all measured
widgets-desc.perf.desc: KarmoLab measuring itself — boot · weight per widget · long tasks · frames · variant boot comparison (for development)
widgets-desc.community.desc: Open talk · questions · show-and-tell · tool requests — where the people who use the tools gather
widgets-desc.plaza.desc: Every number about this site, in the open — visits · tools · community, all measured
widgets-desc.favorites.desc: Keeps the sites and tools you use often in one place
widgets-desc.devtools.desc: A test bench for the desktop app and its integrations (notifications and such)
widgets-desc.localai.desc: Translate and summarise inside this device, with no server — the text never leaves (recent Chromium browsers)
widgets-desc.activity.desc: Which apps and windows took your time on this PC (desktop app only)
widgets-desc.quest-log.desc: A dev task map that reads the memo TASK source of truth and shows project progress
widgets-desc.wm.desc: The game being made — intro · a day in it · world guide · story · news · work in progress
widgets-desc.docs.desc: KarmoLab intro, roadmap and guides plus the character and system wiki — sidebar navigation, body and table of contents
widgets-desc.randomgen.desc: Draws random keywords and prompts for creative work
widgets-desc.passgen.desc: Makes safe passwords and checks how long yours would hold. Nothing is sent anywhere
widgets-desc.devtool.desc: Paste JSON, JWT, Base64, a table — we work out what it is and point at the right tool. JSON opens as a tree
widgets-desc.logview.desc: Drop a big log to see when it spiked, then narrow it down by level and regex — the file never leaves your browser
widgets-desc.bundlemap.desc: Drop in a webpack stats.json or an esbuild metafile to see what is heavy as area — and which packages got bundled twice
widgets-desc.dupphoto.desc: Drop in a pile of photos and the similar ones are grouped, with a suggestion of which to keep. The photos never leave your browser

widgets-desc.prettyall.desc: Lay CSS and HTML out to read, or squeeze them down. What is inside quotes, pre and script is left alone
widgets-desc.sshkey.desc: Paste an authorized_keys file and every line reports its type, size, comment and fingerprint. Public-key PEM converts to an OpenSSH line too
widgets-desc.nettool.desc: Work out where a CIDR starts and ends and how many hosts fit, and whether two ranges overlap. Port numbers are looked up here as well
widgets-desc.csp.desc: Lay a CSP out directive by directive, point at the weak spots, and build a header from what you pick
widgets-desc.semver.desc: Unfold what ^1.2.3 really accepts into plain bounds, and check whether two ranges overlap

widgets-desc.erd.desc: Paste CREATE TABLE statements or a Prisma schema and see the tables, columns and links as a diagram
widgets-desc.sqlfmt.desc: Unfold squashed SQL so the clauses line up, and move it between MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and SQLite
widgets-desc.jqplay.desc: Paste JSON and ask it in jq style — answers appear as you type, and nothing is uploaded
widgets-desc.mockdata.desc: Write the field types and get believable test rows — Korean, English or Japanese names, as CSV, JSON or SQL
widgets-desc.configconv.desc: Convert between .env, YAML, TOML, JSON and .properties. The input format is detected for you
widgets-desc.curlkit.desc: Turn a curl command into fetch, axios, Python or Go code — and send it right here
widgets-desc.diff.desc: Point at what differs between two texts or files. JSON is compared by key path, and a three-way merge is built in
widgets-desc.livecount.desc: The time since that day climbs by the second — with a rough count from “times a day” too
widgets-desc.comparepic.desc: Stack two photos and slide between them — the files never leave your device
widgets-desc.charconv.desc: Full-width ⟷ half-width, Hangul ⟷ Roman letters, Hangul ⟷ jamo in one place — mixed characters are flagged first
widgets-desc.mesh3d.desc: Open an STL or OBJ and turn it around — triangle count and size too, and the file never leaves your device
widgets-desc.dailycho.desc: Five words from their initial consonants alone — the answers are tool names on this site
widgets-desc.dailytype.desc: Three sentences a day · the same for everyone · speed and accuracy
widgets-desc.chain.desc: Run several tools back to back — each result becomes the next tool’s input
widgets-desc.base64.desc: Converts text and Base64 both ways. Non-Latin text survives, URL-safe form supported
widgets-desc.crypto.desc: Encrypts and decrypts text with AES, Base64 and URL encoding
widgets-desc.image.desc: Drop a photo once, then resize, convert, redact or pull colors in a row. Compare before/after with a slider. Nothing leaves your browser
widgets-desc.imageedit.desc: Editing plus format and resolution conversion (PNG, JPEG, WebP and more) on one screen
widgets-desc.imagelib.desc: Stores and manages the images you generated
widgets-desc.tierlist.desc: Builds ranking instances from a candidate pool and exchanges them via blog or local JSON (in progress)
widgets-desc.postgraph.desc: Shows internal link relationships between blog posts as a graph (in progress)
widgets-desc.pulse.desc: Seven stations broadcasting nothing in particular, very regularly — three letters · a bell · a tick · a word · a line · a pattern · a dot
widgets-desc.adventure.desc: An endless text adventure run by GM Timeto (KL-032). Stage = KarmoWorld, history accumulates into wiki entities
widgets-desc.planner.desc: Your own schedule sync and streak kanban board (in progress)
widgets-desc.cockpit.desc: One surface for project structure and status — a Unity Shader Graph style node graph plus a TASK tab (TASK-KL-082, combined widget)

widgets-desc.claude-env.desc: GUI for Claude Code Stop/Notification hook sound alerts — memo/dotfiles is canon (v1: read only; Step 2+: write, sync, preview, wav drag-drop)
widgets-desc.alarm.desc: A desktop alarm that actually gets you up (Free Alarm Clock reference, TASK-KL-064) — resident scheduler, OS-level wake (sleep wake / monitor on / forced volume) and autostart
widgets-desc.slug.desc: Turns a title into URL-safe form. Korean is romanized
widgets-desc.caseconv.desc: Converts camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case and PascalCase. Many lines at once
widgets-desc.linebreak.desc: Rejoins lines chopped by copying from a PDF or the web, or rewraps them to a width you choose
widgets-desc.textclean.desc: Tidies multi-line text in one pass — sort, dedupe, whitespace, numbering
widgets-desc.hangulkey.desc: Recovers text typed without switching the Korean/English key. dkssudgktpdy ↔ 안녕하세요 (2-set layout)
widgets-desc.jamo.desc: Splits syllables into initial, medial and final letters and puts them back. Initial extraction included
widgets-desc.replace.desc: Find and replace in text. Shows the matches before you commit
widgets-desc.listdiff.desc: Sorts out what two lists share and what only one has. Order does not matter
widgets-desc.charcount.desc: Counts characters with and without spaces, bytes, words, sentences and manuscript pages as you type
widgets-desc.wordfreq.desc: Counts the words used most in a text. Korean particles can be stripped
widgets-desc.textdiff.desc: Finds the lines that differ between two texts or code files and colors them (added / removed / same)
widgets-desc.textredact.desc: Finds and removes national ID, phone and card numbers from logs and documents, and reports what it found
widgets-desc.unicodex.desc: Find invisible characters and look-alike letters, then remove the ones you choose
widgets-desc.tts.desc: Have what you wrote read out loud. It follows along sentence by sentence, and you can pick the voice and the speed
widgets-desc.encdetective.desc: Undo the wrong decoding behind garbled text, and say what went wrong
widgets-desc.text2pdf.desc: Turns what you write into an A4 PDF. Korean renders fine and the text never leaves your browser
widgets-desc.text2img.desc: Turns a quote or notice into an image card. Long text is scaled to fit rather than cut
widgets-desc.lorem.desc: Makes placeholder text for mockups. Korean filler or Lorem Ipsum, by paragraph, sentence or word
widgets-desc.checklist.desc: Build a to-do list and share it with one link. No account, no server
widgets-desc.text.desc: Paste once, then count, tidy, compare and re-case in a row. Emoji count the way a person sees them
widgets-desc.timecapsule.desc: A letter nobody can open before the day you set. No server holds it — the locked letter itself is the address
widgets-desc.duel.desc: Two people going at it in a few seconds' worth of mini-games. One link starts it, and the room never sits on our server
widgets-desc.ghosttype.desc: Your typing run becomes a single link, and whoever opens it races your ghost. Any text works, and the link never expires
widgets-desc.pdfdiff.desc: Highlights only what changed between two revisions of a document. It reads text and image together, so a shifted table or stamp gets caught too
widgets-desc.pdf2img.desc: Turns PDF pages into PNG or JPG. Raise the scale and you get print resolution
widgets-desc.img2pdf.desc: Bundles several photos into one PDF, fitted to the paper without distorting
widgets-desc.printkit.desc: Make graph paper, dot grids, manuscript squares, music staves, calendars and label sheets as PDF. Drawn in millimetres, so it lands right on any printer
widgets-desc.ziptool.desc: Bundles files into a ZIP, and lists and extracts a ZIP you received
widgets-desc.pdfwatermark.desc: Lays text across every page of a PDF. Korean works too

widgets-desc.audiojoin.desc: Joins several audio files into one, matching them even when sample rates differ
widgets-desc.imgbatch.desc: Resizes and reformats many photos at once and hands them back as a ZIP
widgets-desc.filehash.desc: Computes a downloaded file's checksum and matches it against the value the publisher listed
widgets-desc.pdftool.desc: Merges PDFs, pulls out pages and rotates them. Files never leave your browser
widgets-desc.audiocut.desc: Cuts out just the stretch you want. Files never leave your browser
widgets-desc.favicon.desc: Builds every site-icon size plus the .ico from a single image, with the markup to paste
widgets-desc.imgmerge.desc: Stitches several images into one, vertically or horizontally. Photos never leave your browser
widgets-desc.pdfsign.desc: Lays a hand-drawn signature onto a contract. No printing or scanning, and the document never leaves your browser
widgets-desc.filesplit.desc: Splits a large file into pieces and rejoins them. Nothing is compressed, so the result is byte-identical
widgets-desc.exifclean.desc: Shows and removes the location and camera data inside a photo, without touching quality, and the photo never leaves your browser
widgets-desc.pdf2text.desc: Extracts PDF text with lines and paragraphs intact. Files never leave your browser

widgets-desc.pdfcrop.desc: Strips the wide margins off scans and papers. The text stays selectable
widgets-desc.pdfpagenum.desc: Adds page numbers to a PDF. Skip the covers and start counting 1 at the body
widgets-desc.pdfredact.desc: Removes personal data from a PDF. Not a black box on top — the text itself is gone
widgets-desc.pdfcompress.desc: Shrinks a scanned PDF. Preview the quality before choosing, and files never leave your browser
widgets-desc.pdf.desc: Drop a PDF once. See every page at a glance, rotate or drop pages, then crop, number and shrink in a row. Nothing leaves your browser
widgets-desc.sound.desc: See the waveform while you trim and tidy. Keep working on the result you just made. Nothing leaves your browser
widgets-desc.filetool.desc: Convert and stitch photos, strip location data, ZIP, split large files. Files never leave your browser
widgets-desc.video2gif.desc: Makes a GIF from the stretch of video you choose. Pick range and quality while watching, and see the result before downloading
widgets-desc.video2audio.desc: Pulls just the sound out of a video file. Files never leave your browser
widgets-desc.videotrim.desc: Cuts out just the stretch you want. Sound comes with it, and the video never leaves your browser
widgets-desc.videorotate.desc: Stands up video shot sideways. Rotating swaps width and height with it
widgets-desc.videocompress.desc: Shrinks a video. Pick resolution and quality; the video never leaves your browser
widgets-desc.video2img.desc: Grabs one frame or frames at an interval at original quality. The video never leaves your browser
widgets-desc.screenrec.desc: Records your screen or a window, with sound. Files never leave your browser
widgets-desc.voicerec.desc: Records straight from your microphone to WAV. You can see the level coming in, and files never leave your browser
widgets-desc.videotool.desc: Drop a video once and see it as a filmstrip. Trim, make a GIF, grab frames or pull the audio in a row. Nothing leaves your browser
widgets-desc.csvjson.desc: Converts a CSV table and JSON both ways. Commas and line breaks inside quotes survive
widgets-desc.tableconv.desc: Turns a table copied from a spreadsheet into Markdown, CSV or JSON. Just paste
widgets-desc.json2ts.desc: Builds TypeScript interfaces from JSON. Arrays are merged across all elements
widgets-desc.xmlfmt.desc: Pretty-print XML, minify it to one line, or convert it to JSON. Problems are pinned to a line and column
widgets-desc.isitdown.desc: Tells whether a site is really down or your own connection is the problem, by measuring always-up sites alongside it
widgets-desc.jsonfmt.desc: Formats JSON readably or minifies it to one line, and points to the line and column of a syntax error
widgets-desc.qrgen.desc: Turns URLs, text, WiFi and contacts into QR codes and saves them as PNG or SVG
widgets-desc.qrread.desc: Reads a QR from an image or your camera and tells you what is inside. Nothing is uploaded
widgets-desc.qr.desc: Making and reading QR codes in one place, so you can check that what you made scans
widgets-desc.draw.desc: Lottery numbers, ghost-leg ladders, draws and team splits in one place
widgets-desc.quest.desc: One puzzle a day that needs a tool to solve — bases, Morse, hashes, units
widgets-desc.packs.desc: Build the sets used in the games yourself — one paste from a spreadsheet is enough

widgets-desc.worldcup.desc: A bracket where you pick one of two — build a set and it becomes your own bracket
widgets-desc.lotto.desc: Draws 1–45 lottery numbers for as many games as you want. Exclusions, pinned numbers and odd/even rules
widgets-desc.timer.desc: A countdown timer and a stopwatch with laps. It chimes when time is up

widgets-desc.workdays.desc: Counts business days with weekends and holidays removed, and shows which days it dropped
widgets-desc.timecalc.desc: Adds time to a clock time and sums hours worked. Keeps base-60 mistakes out
widgets-desc.pace.desc: Converts pace and speed both ways and works back from a goal time
widgets-desc.datecalc.desc: Days between two dates, D-Day, the date N days out, and exact age
widgets-desc.unitconv.desc: Converts length, weight, area (including pyeong), volume, temperature, data, speed and time
widgets-desc.hashgen.desc: Computes MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 of text or a file, right in the browser
widgets-desc.uuidgen.desc: Generates UUID v4 and v7, ULIDs, NanoIDs and safe passwords, as many as you need
widgets-desc.regextest.desc: Tests a regex live and shows matches, groups and the replace result
widgets-desc.color.desc: HEX·RGB·HSL conversion, extracting colors from an image, and the CSS color names, all in one place
widgets-desc.gradient.desc: Build a background gradient while watching it and take the CSS. Mixed so the middle does not go muddy
widgets-desc.contrast.desc: Measures the contrast between text and background and tells you whether it passes accessibility standards
widgets-desc.colorblind.desc: Shows how two colors look under color vision deficiency and judges whether they stay distinguishable
widgets-desc.colorconv.desc: Converts HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK, alongside contrast ratio (readability) and harmony palettes
widgets-desc.askpapers.desc: Ask a question and papers answer — sentences are quoted from their abstracts as written, with links, never invented
widgets-desc.imgresize.desc: Shrinks to a rule like a pixel width or a size cap. It finds the quality for you
widgets-desc.bgremove.desc: Cut a flat or near-flat background away and get a transparent PNG. The photo never leaves your browser
widgets-desc.idphoto.desc: Crop to passport, ID card or résumé sizes, swap the background, and lay several copies onto one print sheet
widgets-desc.docscan.desc: Straighten a document shot at an angle and clean it up like a scan, out as PNG or PDF. The photo never leaves your browser
widgets-desc.ocr.desc: Pull the text out of a photo. A PDF that already holds text is handed to the more accurate tool, and the model is only downloaded if you turn it on
widgets-desc.redact.desc: Removes account numbers and names from a screenshot. Not covered over — the spot is destroyed
widgets-desc.asciiart.desc: Turns a photo or drawing into ASCII art. Width, character set and inversion are adjustable
widgets-desc.radix.desc: Converts binary, octal, decimal and hex at once, with any base 2–36 and bitwise operations
widgets-desc.barcode.desc: Makes barcodes for inventory, book and product labels, and warns about values that will not scan
widgets-desc.icsmake.desc: Turns a meeting or notice into an .ics file for a calendar, with the time zone written correctly
widgets-desc.subtitle.desc: Shifts or stretches subtitles back into sync. Converts between SRT and VTT
widgets-desc.ladder.desc: Put in names and outcomes and it draws the ladder, then traces each pick down to its match
widgets-desc.palette.desc: Pulls the representative colors from a photo into a HEX·RGB palette, copyable as CSS variables
widgets-desc.calc.desc: Write a line, get its answer. Name earlier lines, add VAT, convert units and percentages. Your sheet stays
widgets-desc.numword.desc: Reads numbers out in Korean and turns Korean number words back into digits — the wording used on contracts and receipts
widgets-desc.aspect.desc: Works out sizes while keeping the aspect ratio, with a screen ratio list and margin math
widgets-desc.grade.desc: Computes GPA from per-course credits and grades, plus the grades needed for a target
widgets-desc.vat.desc: Adds VAT to a net amount or pulls it out of a gross one — the three tax-invoice lines as is
widgets-desc.bytesize.desc: Converts KB, MB and GB, showing the 1000-based and 1024-based counts side by side

widgets-desc.cssunit.desc: Converts px, rem, em, pt and %, with root and parent bases side by side
widgets-desc.percent.desc: Discounts, rates of change and ratios — fill the numbers into a plain question
widgets-desc.dutchpay.desc: Divide what a group spent and get who should send how much to whom — in the fewest transfers
widgets-desc.payslip.desc: Take insurance and tax off a salary to see what actually lands in your account, including tax-free pay and dependants
widgets-desc.interest.desc: Maturity amounts for deposits and savings and monthly loan payments, with the 15.4% interest tax applied
widgets-desc.urlparse.desc: Restores mangled addresses, lays out query parameters and strips tracking ones
widgets-desc.jwt.desc: Unpacks a JWT's header and payload and shows the expiry and time left
widgets-desc.cron.desc: Reads a cron expression in plain language and actually computes the next run times
widgets-desc.epoch.desc: Converts Unix timestamps and human-readable time, detecting seconds versus milliseconds
widgets-desc.worldclock.desc: Current time per city and the offset from Seoul, with daylight saving applied
widgets-desc.morse.desc: Turns letters into Morse and reads it back. Korean Morse plus sound and light playback
widgets-desc.pick.desc: Draws from a list, splits teams and sets an order — no repeats, fairly
widgets-desc.bmi.desc: Computes BMI from height and weight against both the Korean and WHO standards
widgets-desc.reference.desc: git commands, Markdown, HTTP status, shortcuts, file extensions and key codes, all in one place
widgets-desc.charmap.desc: Special characters, emoji, HTML entities and ASCII — find and click to copy
widgets-desc.specialchar.desc: Arrows, stars, shapes, math symbols and other characters your keyboard lacks — click to copy
widgets-desc.ascii.desc: The 0–127 ASCII characters with decimal, hex and binary values and what the control codes mean
widgets-desc.htmlentity.desc: HTML entity codes such as &nbsp; &lt; &copy; alongside the characters, ready to copy
widgets-desc.httpstatus.desc: A table of HTTP response codes such as 200, 301, 403, 404 and 500 with what they mean and when they are used
widgets-desc.colorname.desc: The 148 standard CSS color names with HEX values, compared by eye and copied with a click
widgets-desc.keycode.desc: Press a key and it shows event.key, event.code and keyCode on the spot
widgets-desc.emoji.desc: Search in Korean to find an emoji and click to copy — faces, hands, symbols and more by category
widgets-desc.markdown.desc: Look up Markdown syntax — headings, tables, code blocks, checkboxes — and copy it as is (GFM)
widgets-desc.regexref.desc: Find regex symbols and common patterns by what you are trying to do, then copy
widgets-desc.gitcmd.desc: Find the git command by what you want to do. Irreversible ones are marked
widgets-desc.filetype.desc: What an extension is and what opens it — images, documents, archives, code and more
widgets-desc.shortcut.desc: Windows, macOS, browser and VS Code shortcuts — only the ones you actually end up using
widgets-desc.stash.desc: Unsorted experiments, alive in one box
widgets-desc.laptop.desc: The laptop running 24/7 at home — the door to file sharing and build status
widgets-desc.orbita.desc: A polyrhythm sequencer you build by dotting colors onto orbits — browser synth plus MIDI out
widgets-desc.bluemarble.desc: Earth at this very moment — day and night, city lights, the quake that just happened, the ISS overhead
widgets-desc.garden.desc: A grid that grows itself from one rule a day — you just watch

widgets-desc.collection.desc: Every tool you have used gets a stamp — how many squares have you filled

widgets-desc.play.desc: One round a day — guess the one, pick the higher, puzzle of the day
widgets-desc.bounce.desc: Bounce the ball in a simple arcade game
widgets-desc.darkroom.desc: Shine a mouse-controlled light through a dark room
widgets-desc.folder.desc: An easter egg where folders multiply forever
widgets-desc.fontgacha.desc: Change fonts through a gacha draw
widgets-desc.hacker.desc: Mash the keyboard to print fake hacker text
widgets-desc.particle.desc: Move particles with the mouse and explode them with a click
widgets-desc.password.desc: A game where you guess a 4-digit password from hints
widgets-desc.pet.desc: Pet the cat and raise its affection
widgets-desc.shylink.desc: A minigame where you catch a moving link
widgets-desc.stone.desc: Throw stones and read the omen
